background: OP Corporate Bank is the corporate and central banking entity of OP Financial Group, Finland's largest financial group, handling wholesale funding, corporate lending and markets for the cooperative member banks.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the bank, at AA- on average and both on a stable outlook, the third having withdrawn its rating on 6 Jan 2016. Capital is on the weak side of EU and Nordic peers, with CET1 of 14.2% below the peer median, though as a group entity it is capitalised to serve the whole cooperative rather than on its own. Liquidity is strong, with LCR of 191% in the top quarter and NSFR of 130% above the peer median, and none of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days; the comfort is the mutual group's joint liability, which the ratings reflect.
